Around [[3653 BBY]],<ref name="Timeline" /> near the end of the [[Great Galactic War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]], a '''strike team''' of [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Assassination of Darth Azamin|infiltrated]] the [[Darth Azamin's stronghold|stronghold]] of the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Darth Azamin]].<ref name="Codex" /> The mission was arranged by agents of Azamin's rival [[Darth Decimus]],<ref name="Encyclopedia">''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic Encyclopedia]]''</ref> and saw the Jedi successfully [[Death/Legends|kill]] Azamin, though they all died themselves when the [[Starship/Legends|starship]] they used to escape exploded due to sabotage.<ref name="Codex" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Jedi strike team was mentioned in the Codex entry for Darth Decimus in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'', a [[Star Wars video games|video game]] released by [[BioWare]] in [[2011]].<ref name="Codex" />
